messages:
lina-proc: Heads-up — NovaTech just bumped our H100 tranche to ~7 weeks due to fab backlog. This will pinch us in us-west-2 next week.

omar-ops: We're down to ~6 hot units. Nightly canary needs 2. If delay holds we'll exhaust hot pool by Tue.

tara-sre: Mitigations: shift non-critical tenants to eu-west-1, enable model fallbacks, reduce max_batch_tokens. Cross-region egress and tail latency will increase though.

lina-proc: NovaTech offered a priority split: 6 units by air (48-72h) + 10 units expedited sea (~2w). Air surcharge +20% per unit. They also have depot exchange option for 3 DOA/refurb units if we provide serials+photos. Need amendment sign-off. @ben-finance

selene-transport: Air requires clean AWB docs + customs broker (~36-48h). Courier can do next-day pickup after docs. Depot can release 3 exchange H100s in ~72h once we submit serials and photos and pay courier.

lina-proc: Uploaded manifest to vendor portal: SNNT-9001, SNNT-9002, SNNT-9003. AWB: 111222333US. Carrier: AeroLine. Insurance: yes. PO: PO-9001. Link: https://redwood.infra/po/PO-9001

logistics-bot: [shipment logged] https://shipper.example/track/111222333US :truck:

ben-finance: Quick cost estimate: full air for 16 units ~= +$45k. Split air + sea + depot exchange ~= +$26k. Can charge to cost center 51 if approved.

omar-ops: If we go split, schedule a canary flip Fri 02:00 UTC and notify #eng-sre. We'll measure p99 and error budget during the window.

tara-sre: I'll prepare the rollback playbook: fallback routes to `redwood-lite` for latency-sensitive tenants, reduce concurrency, and lower batch size. Adding egress-cost alert to Ops dashboard.

ben-finance: Approve split air + depot exchange, charge to 51. Lina, please send the signed amendment and manifest now. :thumbsup:

selene-transport: Booking broker & courier now. Will post AWB PDF and pickup ETA once confirmed. Depot needs serials+photos by EOD to release exchanges.

lina-proc: Sending depot photos and serials to vendor & depot now. Amending PO and attaching signed amendment. Will update here when AWB scan is uploaded.

omar-ops: Standing by to coordinate the canary flip and engage on-call SRE when AWB is live.

lina-proc: Closing for now; will update on pickup confirmation and tracking.
